question: Cartilage tissue is absent in which of the following organs of the body?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kidney**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Cartilage tissue is a specialized connective tissue that provides support, flexibility, and structure to various parts of the body.
 
• It is absent in the kidney, which is an organ primarily composed of epithelial, connective, and nervous tissues.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nose:** Cartilage forms the framework of the nose, providing structure and flexibility.
 
• **Larynx:** Cartilage is a key component of the larynx, or voice box, helping to support the vocal cords and regulate airflow.
 
• **Ear:** Cartilage is present in the outer ear, providing structure and protection.
 
 
• It is also found in the middle ear, where it forms the malleus, incus, and stapes, three tiny bones involved in hearing.
